title: Exact Rational and Constructive Lean 4 Certificates for Non-Additivity of Extension Complexity Under Cartesian Products
abstract: Minhao Liu (arXiv:2611.33631v1, Nov. 2026) disproves Conjecture 1.2 of Grande, Padrol, and Sanyal by proving that linear extension complexity is not additive under Cartesian products: an explicit 24-dimensional rational polytope P with 50 facets and 150 vertices satisfies xc(P) = 40 and xc(P x P) = 79, while infinite families achieve linear-fraction deficits delta(U_n, V_n) >= ceil(5n/27) and unbounded Cartesian-square deficits delta(R_t, R_t) >= t. We present an independent, unrefereed companion verification suite (EXT-COMPLEXITY-PROD-CERT-1.0) comprising 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice), a strictly zero-floating-point Python verifier over exact Z and Q checking four verification modes (eight submodes), 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 43 unit and adversarial forgery tests.
